[b][size=3]OVERVIEW[/size][/b]

This is a furry mod for Stardew Valley, replacing Elliott with a lion version of himself. Most of the changes are just to the face area, but hopefully you enjoy it nonetheless. I plan to redo all of the characters in time! 

This mod was created solely by Lewdliege! You can find me on [url=https://twitter.com/lewdliege?lang=en]twitter under the same name (18+ only)[/url]﻿.

[size=3][b]INSTALLATION[/b]
[/size]
[color=#fff2cc]This mod is probably not compatible with other mods that change the appearance of Elliott.
[/color]
This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿. To install, unpack and place the "[CP] Lewdliege Furry Elliott" folder into your Mods folder.﻿   ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[/center]
